title: 36 Hours in Hood River, Ore.
abstract: Whether you’re into beer or biking, wine or water sports, you can indulge in this area on the Columbia River east of Portland.

title: 36 Hours in Seville, Spain
abstract: Go on a tapas crawl, take a high-tech tour and even do a little late-night dancing during a weekend in the Andalusian capital.

title: 36 Hours in Prague
abstract: Many locals still haven’t heard of all the next big things: flashy new art galleries, dynamically developing old neighborhoods, great bars — beyond and including beer — and new restaurants.

title: 36 Hours in Belo Horizonte, Brazil
abstract: The World Cup is coming soon to this lively industrial capital of Brazil’s second most populous state. Here’s some of what soccer fans — and other visitors — can expect to find.
